name: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition
description: Bedrock dedicated server using the maintained itzg image. Uses UDP only.

install.script:
set -e
echo 'Bedrock server files are managed by the container image.'
printf 'server-name=%s
gamemode=survival
max-players=%s
online-mode=true
' "$SERVER_NAME" "$MAX_PLAYERS" > server.properties
echo 'Install complete'

variables.name: Accept Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set to TRUE to accept https://minecraft.net/eula.

notes: Bedrock requires a UDP allocation. The image writes worlds into /home/container/worlds.
